summary.text: Rod Moser is a real estate broker and the Democratic candidate for the Utah House of Representatives, District 45, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where the incumbent is Republican Tracy Miller.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he listed affordable housing, fair taxes, protecting public lands and fair wages as his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Rod Moser graduated from South Summit High School and earned an associate degree from the College of Eastern Utah in 1994, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as a real estate broker.
In his survey responses, he said Utah needs a government that works for the people, with accountability and restored trust.
He said that mandates may be needed to address housing affordability and that he wants a tax code that works for everyone.
